name: catalog-filter-simple
description: Ladder for the catalog filter control (catalogFilters, simple tier). Enters the room editor, opens the catalog, seeds a remote CC0 entry so the Availability facet is meaningful, opens the filter popover, applies 'Not downloaded' (grid narrows to remote/shared cards only), then resets to All (grid restored). Verifies the funnel button, the popover groups, and that filtering + reset change the visible grid.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: seed-remote-cc0
steps.eval: window.__store.setState((s)=>({ remoteIndexes: { ...s.remoteIndexes, polyhaven: { status: 'ready', entries: [{ provider: 'polyhaven', slug: 'cozy_sofa', kind: 'furniture', name: 'Cozy Sofa', category: 'seating', thumbUrl: '', resolutions: ['2k'], attribution: 'Poly Haven', sourceUrl: 'https://polyhaven.com/a/cozy_sofa' }] } } }))

steps.name: stash-before-count
steps.eval: window.__filterBefore = document.querySelectorAll('.card-grid .cat-card').length; if (window.__filterBefore < 2) throw new Error('Expected several cards before filtering, got ' + window.__filterBefore)

steps.name: verify-filter-button
steps.eval: (function(){ const b = document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Filter catalog"]'); if (!b) throw new Error('Filter button not found in catalog header'); })()

steps.name: verify-availability-group
steps.eval: (function(){ const p = document.querySelector('.cat-filter-panel'); if (!p || !p.textContent.includes('Not downloaded')) throw new Error('Availability facet not rendered — expected a remote/shared card to make it meaningful'); })()

steps.name: assert-grid-narrowed
steps.eval: (function(){ const now = document.querySelectorAll('.card-grid .cat-card').length; if (now >= window.__filterBefore) throw new Error('Grid did not narrow after Not-downloaded (before ' + window.__filterBefore + ', now ' + now + ')'); if (now < 1) throw new Error('Expected at least the seeded remote card to remain'); })()

steps.name: assert-grid-restored
steps.eval: (function(){ const now = document.querySelectorAll('.card-grid .cat-card').length; if (now !== window.__filterBefore) throw new Error('Grid not restored after reset (expected ' + window.__filterBefore + ', got ' + now + ')'); })()
